requirement_text: User shall/will have access to a system with a mean time between failures of at least 500 hours.
user_story: As a user, I want a system with a mean time between failures of at least 500 hours, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Engineer and verify the system for a mean time between failures of at least 500 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system in operation, when its mean time between failures is calculated, then it is at least 500 hours.
Given a calculated mean time between failures below 500 hours, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to view change history for a particular record or data set in accordance with users’ scope of practice organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the ability to view change history for a particular record or data set in accordance with users’ scope of practice  organizational policy  or jurisdictional law.
user_story: As a records manager, I want to view the change history of a record or data set according to scope of practice, organizational policy or jurisdictional law, so that changes can be reviewed.
technical_task: Provide a change history view for a particular record or data set that follows the user's scope of practice, organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
acceptance_criteria: Given a record or data set that has been changed, when an authorized user opens its change history, then the changes are shown.
Given a user whose scope of practice or policy does not permit it, when the user opens the change history, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: records manager. The policies are not specified.

requirement_text: A tablet shall allow a waiter to process a payment using cash.
user_story: As a waiter, I want to process a payment in cash on a tablet, so that I can take cash payments at the table.
technical_task: Support cash payment processing on the waiter's tablet.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bill on the tablet, when the waiter processes a payment using cash, then the payment is recorded.
Given a recorded cash payment, when the bill is viewed, then it shows the cash payment.

requirement_text: System shall secure all information in the library database and transactions, providing authentication for all users and restricting access to authenticated users only.
user_story: As a librarian, I want all library database information and transactions secured, with access limited to authenticated users, so that library data is protected.
technical_task: Require authentication for all users and restrict access to the library database and its transactions to authenticated users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated user, when the user accesses the library database or a transaction, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not authenticated, when the user tries to access the library database or a transaction, then access is denied.

requirement_text: All details of technical values according to ambient temperature of 23°C ± 5°C (RT) and nominal voltage of 13,5 V ± 0,5 V at the ECU.
rationale: The sentence names a test condition and no behaviour, and refers to values defined elsewhere.
clarification_questions: What must the system do with "all details of technical values"?
Which technical values are meant, and what are the tolerances?

requirement_text: Backplane connector form factors shall be in accordance with the VME64 with extensions (5 row P1 and P2) draft standard.
requirement_text_raw: Backplane connector form factors shall (3.2.3.1.2.5) be in accordance with the VME64 with extensions (5 row P1 and P2) draft standard.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the backplane connector form factors to follow the VME64 draft standard with extensions (5 row P1 and P2), so that boards are compatible.
technical_task: Design the backplane connectors to comply with VME64 and its extensions, using 5 row P1 and P2 connectors.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backplane connectors, when their form factor is checked, then it conforms to the VME64 draft standard with extensions.
Given connectors P1 and P2, when they are inspected, then they are 5 row connectors.

requirement_text: This section addresses the following: (I) numbering plan requirements; standardised telephone numbers; group numbers; calls from external networks to the EIRENE network.
requirement_text_raw: 9.1.2 This section addresses the following: (I) numbering plan requirements; standardised telephone numbers; group numbers; calls from external networks to the EIRENE network.
rationale: The sentence only lists the topics a section covers.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a section summary?
What must the system provide for numbering plans, group numbers and calls from external networks?

requirement_text: The program shall support taking roll for class sizes of up to 100 students while maintaining performance requirements.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to take roll for classes of up to 100 students without losing performance, so that attendance is quick.
technical_task: Support roll taking for class sizes of up to 100 students while meeting the performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class of up to 100 students, when the teacher takes roll, then the program supports it.
Given a class of 100 students, when roll is taken, then the performance requirements are still met.
rationale: Role assumed: teacher. The performance requirements are defined elsewhere.

requirement_text: To clear the failure, FDIR shall request the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to that FCR.
requirement_text_raw: To clear the failure, FDIR shall (3.3.5.15) request the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to that FCR.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to ask the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to the FCR to clear a failure, so that the failure is cleared.
technical_task: Have FDIR send a request to the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to the failed FCR in order to clear the failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure of an FCR, when FDIR tries to clear it, then it requests the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to that FCR.
Given the request has been made, when the Vehicle/Mission Manager acts on it, then power is cycled to that FCR.

requirement_text: The system shall scan documents and convert them into digital files (e.g., PDF, JPG, PNG) as specified by the user.
user_story: As an office worker, I want to scan documents and convert them to digital files such as PDF, JPG or PNG as I choose, so that I can store them electronically.
technical_task: Scan documents and convert the scans into digital files in a format selected by the user, for example PDF, JPG or PNG.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scanned document, when the user selects a format such as PDF, JPG or PNG, then a file in that format is produced.
Given a scanned document, when the conversion completes, then the digital file contains the scanned content.

requirement_text: System shall notify the user upon successful sharing of the video.
user_story: As a user, I want to be notified when my video has been shared successfully, so that I know it worked.
technical_task: Send a notification to the user after a video is shared successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video is shared successfully, when sharing completes, then the user is notified.
Given sharing fails, when it ends, then no success notification is sent.

requirement_text: Clients shall be able to calculate fare.
user_story: As a client, I want to calculate the fare, so that I know the cost before I commit.
technical_task: Provide a fare calculation function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given trip details, when the client requests a fare calculation, then a fare is shown.
Given different trip details, when the client requests a fare calculation, then the fare reflects those details.
rationale: Role stated: client. How the fare is computed is not described.

requirement_text: Software tools and pre-built applications that do not have source code available shall come with a complete diagnostic package and customer support.
user_story: As a customer, I want software tools and pre-built applications without available source code to come with a diagnostic package and customer support, so that I can resolve problems.
technical_task: Deliver every software tool and pre-built application that has no source code available together with a complete diagnostic package and customer support.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software tool or pre-built application without source code, when it is delivered, then it comes with a complete diagnostic package.
Given a software tool or pre-built application without source code, when it is delivered, then customer support is provided for it.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. What "complete" contains is not defined.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to filter their view by Academic Year/Term or Current.
user_story: As a student, I want to filter my view by Academic Year/Term or Current, so that I see only the period I need.
technical_task: Add a filter for Academic Year/Term and a Current option to the view.
acceptance_criteria: Given the view, when the user selects an Academic Year/Term, then only items from it are shown.
Given the view, when the user selects Current, then only current items are shown.

requirement_text: A dynamic behaviour of blending from short to long and vice versa is strongly recommended.
rationale: "Strongly recommended" makes it optional and the behaviour is not described.
clarification_questions: Is the blending behaviour required or only recommended?
What does blending from short to long and back mean, and what must the system do?

requirement_text: Acknowledgement of roll received must be returned within 8 seconds.
user_story: As a teacher, I want the acknowledgement of a received roll to come back within 8 seconds, so that I know the roll was recorded.
technical_task: Return the acknowledgement that the roll was received within 8 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a roll is submitted, when it is received, then the acknowledgement is returned within 8 seconds.
Given an acknowledgement that takes longer than 8 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the longitudinally nearest object classified as TRUCK or CAR leaves the detection field of the sensor, relating objects classified as MULTIPLE have to be labelled still as MULTIPLE.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want objects labelled MULTIPLE to stay MULTIPLE when the nearest TRUCK or CAR leaves the detection field, so that labels remain consistent.
technical_task: Keep objects classified as MULTIPLE labelled as MULTIPLE after the longitudinally nearest object classified as TRUCK or CAR leaves the sensor's detection field.
acceptance_criteria: Given the longitudinally nearest object classified as TRUCK or CAR leaves the detection field, when the sensor updates, then related objects classified as MULTIPLE are still labelled MULTIPLE.
Given a related object classified as MULTIPLE, when the nearest object leaves, then the label does not change.

requirement_text: FABS user shall not receive DABS banner messages and vice versa.
user_story: As a FABS user, I want not to receive DABS banner messages, and the reverse, so that I only see messages meant for me.
technical_task: Show DABS banner messages only to DABS users and FABS banner messages only to FABS users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a FABS user, when banner messages are displayed, then no DABS banner message is shown.
Given a DABS user, when banner messages are displayed, then no FABS banner message is shown.
rationale: Role stated: FABS user. "Vice versa" is read as DABS users not receiving FABS messages.

requirement_text: If the system includes hardware the system shall include documentation that covers the expected physical environment necessary for proper secure and reliable operation of the system including: electrical HVAC sterilization and work area.
requirement_text_raw: If the system includes hardware  the system shall include documentation that covers the expected physical environment necessary for proper secure and reliable operation of the system including: electrical  HVAC  sterilization  and work area.
user_story: As a facility manager, I want documentation of the expected physical environment for any hardware in the system, so that it operates securely and reliably.
technical_task: Include documentation of the expected physical environment (electrical, HVAC, sterilization and work area) when the system includes hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system that includes hardware, when its documentation is reviewed, then it covers the expected physical environment.
Given the physical environment documentation, when it is read, then it covers electrical, HVAC, sterilization and work area.

requirement_text: The system shall implement comprehensive security measures to safeguard users from harm.
rationale: "Comprehensive security measures" and "harm" are not defined.
clarification_questions: What harm to users is meant and how is protection verified?

requirement_text: The system shall allow for addition or deletion of instructors, students, and classes while incorporating new semesters.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add or delete instructors, students and classes when introducing new semesters, so that records stay current.
technical_task: Support adding and deleting instructors, students and classes as part of incorporating a new semester.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new semester, when the administrator adds an instructor, a student or a class, then it is saved.
Given a new semester, when the administrator deletes an instructor, a student or a class, then it is removed.

requirement_text: The FDIR shall be able to discriminate between permanent and non-permanent faults.
requirement_text_raw: The FDIR shall (3.3.5.13) be able to discriminate between permanent and non-permanent faults.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to distinguish permanent from non-permanent faults, so that recovery fits the fault.
technical_task: Classify each detected fault in FDIR as permanent or non-permanent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a permanent fault, when FDIR evaluates it, then it is identified as permanent.
Given a non-permanent fault, when FDIR evaluates it, then it is identified as non-permanent.

requirement_text: The Application Provider is responsible for Returning receipts for load, install, delete, and extradition, according to the Card Issuer's policy.
user_story: As a card issuer, I want the Application Provider to return receipts for load, install, delete and extradition according to my policy, so that each operation is confirmed.
technical_task: Make the Application Provider responsible for returning receipts for load, install, delete and extradition as the Card Issuer's policy requires.
acceptance_criteria: Given a load, install, delete or extradition operation, when it completes, then the Application Provider returns a receipt.
Given the Card Issuer's policy, when a receipt is returned, then it follows that policy.
rationale: Role assumed: card issuer. The policy itself is not described.

requirement_text: User shall be able to download the Skype application from an application store or similar service on their mobile phone without any charge.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want to download Skype from an application store or similar service without any charge, so that I can use it for free.
technical_task: Make the Skype application available for free download from an application store or similar service on mobile phones.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile phone, when the user looks for Skype in an application store or similar service, then it can be downloaded.
Given the download, when the user downloads Skype, then no charge is made.

requirement_text: The system shall be available at all times, allowing user access via a web browser, except during server downtime.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times through a web browser, except during server downtime, so that I can use it whenever needed.
technical_task: Keep the system continuously available through a web browser outside of server downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server is up, when a user opens the system in a web browser, then it is available.
Given server downtime, when a user opens the system, then unavailability is accepted as the stated exception.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card to halt processing if any of the MPE tests, mentioned in Table 3.3.2.3, ICP/PMC1553 IBIT Table, fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.3.2.35) configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card to halt processing if any of the MPE tests, mentioned in Table 3.3.2.3, ICP/PMC1553 IBIT Table, fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP system to configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail, so that a card failing its tests does not keep running.
technical_task: Configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card so processing halts when any of the MPE tests listed in Table 3.3.2.3 fail.
acceptance_criteria: Given an MPE test in Table 3.3.2.3, when it fails, then the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card halts processing.
Given all MPE tests in Table 3.3.2.3 pass, when the card runs, then processing continues.

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability to record the user ID and date of all updates to the problem or diagnosis list.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the user ID and date recorded for every update to the problem or diagnosis list, so that changes can be attributed.
technical_task: Record the user ID and date for each update made to the problem list or diagnosis list.
acceptance_criteria: Given an update to the problem list, when it is saved, then the user ID and date are recorded.
Given an update to the diagnosis list, when it is saved, then the user ID and date are recorded.

requirement_text: User shall be able to send instant messages to any contact on their WhatsApp list, with delivery notifications displayed.
user_story: As a WhatsApp user, I want to send instant messages to any contact on my list and see delivery notifications, so that I know they arrived.
technical_task: Allow instant messages to any contact in the user's list and display a delivery notification for each message.
acceptance_criteria: Given a contact on the user's list, when the user sends an instant message, then the message is sent to the contact.
Given a sent message, when it is delivered, then a delivery notification is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: WhatsApp user, as named in the requirement.

requirement_text: If a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present (for details see [PLGW_R-109] chapter "Starting the PLC modem" [SCC-6187]) the component shall go to state "PLC enabled".
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the component to go to state "PLC enabled" when a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present, so that the PLC modem starts.
technical_task: Switch the component to the state "PLC enabled" whenever a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present.
acceptance_criteria: Given a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present, when the component evaluates it, then the component goes to state "PLC enabled".
Given no condition to activate the PLC chipset is present, when the component evaluates it, then the component does not go to state "PLC enabled".
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The conditions are described in a referenced chapter.

requirement_text: User shall receive the product list within 2 seconds of requesting it, ensuring a responsive interface.
user_story: As a customer, I want to receive the product list within 2 seconds of asking for it, so that the interface feels responsive.
technical_task: Deliver the product list within 2 seconds of a request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request for the product list, when the response is measured, then the list is received within 2 seconds.
Given a response that takes longer than 2 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Is there no vehicle traction standby release from level2 for a time longer than a calibratable time (1 second) after rising edge of T50, then the vehicle traction standby release (FBA_E2) will be irreversibly deactivated for the current driving cycle and an error will be stored in failure memory.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the vehicle traction standby release irreversibly deactivated for the driving cycle, with an error stored, when no release comes from level2 within the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50, so that a faulty release is not used.
technical_task: Deactivate the vehicle traction standby release (FBA_E2) irreversibly for the current driving cycle and store an error in failure memory when there is no standby release from level2 for longer than the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50.
acceptance_criteria: Given no vehicle traction standby release from level2 for longer than the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50, when the time has passed, then FBA_E2 is irreversibly deactivated for the current driving cycle.
Given the same condition, when FBA_E2 is deactivated, then an error is stored in failure memory.

requirement_text: The solution should implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
user_story: As a security officer, I want technical security measures that guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information in transit, so that it is protected on the network.
technical_task: Implement technical security measures against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information transmitted over an electronic communications network.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic protected health information on an electronic communications network, when an unauthorized party tries to access it, then access is prevented.
Given electronic protected health information being transmitted, when it is sent, then the security measures are applied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant‘s accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.  This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant‘s accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'
user_story: As a dispute analyst, I want the Disputes application to interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System and send all adjustment requests there, so that account adjustments can be requested.
technical_task: Connect the Disputes application to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System and route every adjustment request for cardmember and merchant accounts through it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute needing an account adjustment, when the Disputes application requests it, then the request is sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
Given any adjustment request, when it is sent, then it goes only to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
rationale: Role assumed: dispute analyst. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "merchant's".

requirement_text: User shall view and respond to posts from other users.
user_story: As a user, I want to view and respond to posts from other users, so that I can take part in discussions.
technical_task: Show posts from other users and allow replies to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given posts from other users, when the user opens the feed, then the posts are shown.
Given a post, when the user responds, then the response is saved and shown with the post.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each ICP to continue processing if any of the Power-up or Initial BIT tests fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS289] configure each ICP to continue processing if any of the Power-up or Initial BIT tests fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to configure each ICP to keep processing if any Power-up or Initial BIT test fails, so that a test failure does not stop the ICP.
technical_task: Configure each ICP so processing continues when a Power-up or Initial BIT test fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Power-up test fails on an ICP, when the ICP is configured by the FTSS, then it continues processing.
Given an Initial BIT test fails on an ICP, when the ICP is configured by the FTSS, then it continues processing.

requirement_text: System shall be able to seamlessly integrate metadata from external sources into DMPs.
rationale: "Seamlessly" is subjective and the external sources are not named.
clarification_questions: What does "seamlessly" mean in measurable terms?
Which external sources and which metadata fields are involved?

requirement_text: Upon successful login, user shall be able to send and receive emails.
user_story: As a user, I want to send and receive emails after logging in, so that I can communicate.
technical_task: Enable sending and receiving email once login succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when the user composes an email and sends it, then it is sent.
Given a successful login, when an email arrives, then the user can receive it.

requirement_text: A patient is presented with a listing of all immunizations for which he or she has been administered in the last 12 months.
user_story: As a patient, I want a list of all immunizations I received in the last 12 months, so that I know my recent vaccinations.
technical_task: Display the list of immunizations administered to the patient in the last 12 months.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with immunizations in the last 12 months, when the patient opens the list, then those immunizations are listed.
Given an immunization older than 12 months, when the patient opens the list, then it is not listed.

requirement_text: A patient either chooses to input his or her physiologic measurements (blood pressure possibly and possibly glucose levels) or to input his or her weight height possibly and possibly pedometer readings .
requirement_text_raw: A patient either chooses to input his or her physiologic measurements (blood pressure possibly and possibly glucose levels)   or to input his or her weight  height  possibly and possibly pedometer readings .
user_story: As a patient, I want to enter either my physiologic measurements or my weight, height and pedometer readings, so that my record is current.
technical_task: Offer two input choices: physiologic measurements (blood pressure and optionally glucose levels) or weight, height and optional pedometer readings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the input options, when the patient chooses physiologic measurements, then blood pressure and glucose levels can be entered.
Given the input options, when the patient chooses weight and height, then weight, height and pedometer readings can be entered.
rationale: Role stated: patient. "Possibly" marks the glucose levels and pedometer readings as optional.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to save the new task by tapping "Save" after filling in all the fields.
user_story: As a user, I want to save the new task by tapping Save after filling in all the fields, so that the task is stored.
technical_task: Add a Save button that stores the new task once all fields are filled in.
acceptance_criteria: Given all fields of a new task are filled in, when the user taps Save, then the task is saved.
Given a field is empty, when the user taps Save, then the task is not saved.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion follows from "after filling in all the fields".

requirement_text: The solution should provide the capability to document or record that identity-proofing was completed and the method used to verify (i.e. check photo id prior relationship or verification of information an individual knows or can produce) consistent with the recommendations of the Confidentiality or Privacy or Security Workgroup of the American Health Information Community.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the capability to document or record that identity-proofing was completed and the method used to verify (i.e.  check photo id  prior relationship  or verification of information an individual knows or can produce) consistent with the recommendations of the Confidentiality or Privacy or Security Workgroup of the American Health Information Community.
user_story: As a registrar, I want to record that identity-proofing was completed and the method used, so that the proof can be audited.
technical_task: Provide a way to document that identity-proofing was done and which verification method was used, such as checking a photo ID, a prior relationship or verification of known information.
acceptance_criteria: Given identity-proofing has been completed, when the user records it, then the completion is saved.
Given identity-proofing has been recorded, when the record is viewed, then the verification method used is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The recommendations of the workgroup are only referenced.

requirement_text: System shall keep error tracking logs to aid users.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to keep error tracking logs, so that problems can be investigated.
technical_task: Keep error tracking logs for the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it is written to the error tracking log.
Given the error tracking log, when a user opens it, then the recorded errors are available.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How the logs aid users is not described.

requirement_text: When answer to the security question is typed in the answer should not appear on the screen (similar to how a password normally appears) and the answer should be confirmed (by the patient or personal health representative) before it is saved.
requirement_text_raw: When answer to the security question is typed in  the answer should not appear on the screen (similar to how a password normally appears) and the answer should be confirmed (by the patient or personal health representative) before it is saved.
user_story: As a patient, I want my security answer hidden as I type it and confirmed before it is saved, so that nobody can read it over my shoulder.
technical_task: Mask the security question answer as it is typed, like a password, and require confirmation by the patient or personal health representative before saving it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient types the answer to the security question, when it is typed, then it does not appear on the screen.
Given an answer has been typed, when the patient or personal health representative confirms it, then the answer is saved.
rationale: Role stated: patient or personal health representative.

requirement_text: The SD Card Slot shall support all kinds of SD / MMC Cards with smaller form factors (e.g. mini SD) via adapter.
user_story: As a device user, I want the SD card slot to support all kinds of SD / MMC cards with smaller form factors via an adapter, so that I can use my smaller cards.
technical_task: Make the SD card slot accept SD / MMC cards with smaller form factors, for example mini SD, through an adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Given an SD or MMC card with a smaller form factor and an adapter, when it is inserted in the slot, then it is supported.
Given a mini SD card in an adapter, when it is inserted, then it can be used.

requirement_text: The Operations Management & Communication capabilities should conform to the IN 1.7 Secure Data Routing requirements when solution data exchanges with other sources or destinations of data to ensure that the exchange occurs only among authorized senders and receivers.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the Operations Management & Communication capabilities to follow the IN 1.7 Secure Data Routing requirements, so that data is exchanged only among authorized senders and receivers.
technical_task: Make the Operations Management & Communication capabilities conform to the IN 1.7 Secure Data Routing requirements when solution data is exchanged with other sources or destinations.
acceptance_criteria: Given solution data is exchanged with another source or destination, when the exchange takes place, then it is only among authorized senders and receivers.
Given a sender or receiver that is not authorized, when it tries to take part in an exchange, then it is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. IN 1.7 is only referenced.

requirement_text: The system shall allow searching for resources based on various metadata criteria.
clarification_questions: Which metadata criteria can be used to search?

requirement_text: User shall utilize Client ID and Demat account number for quick data retrieval.
rationale: "Quick" is not measurable and the retrieved data is not named.
clarification_questions: What does "quick" retrieval mean in measurable terms?
What data is retrieved with the Client ID and Demat account number?

requirement_text: For details see [PLGW_R-109] chapter "MAC address configuration" [SCC-2891].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced chapter on MAC address configuration require?
Is the referenced chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: System shall encrypt transactions to protect them from unauthorized interception.
user_story: As a customer, I want my transactions encrypted, so that they cannot be intercepted by unauthorized parties.
technical_task: Encrypt transactions in transit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction is sent, when it travels over the network, then it is encrypted.
Given an unauthorized party intercepts a transaction, when it reads the data, then the data cannot be understood.

requirement_text: System shall offer a registration form for users.
user_story: As a new user, I want a registration form, so that I can create an account.
technical_task: Provide a registration form for users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration page, when the user opens it, then a registration form is shown.
Given the registration form, when the user fills it in and submits, then the registration is submitted.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The form fields are not listed.
